metadata.description: Claude Code skills and hooks from Christopher Boone (cboone.github.io)

plugins.description: Set up scrut snapshot-based CLI integration testing for a CLI project.
plugins.name: add-scrut-cli-tests

plugins.description: Fetch a GitHub issue, plan the work, stop for approval, then execute changes and commit with issue references.
plugins.name: address-issue

plugins.description: Parse a review document for actionable feedback, work through items systematically, and track resolution progress.
plugins.name: address-review

plugins.description: Assess a repository, determine what scaffolding and setup tools are needed, present a plan, and execute them in the correct order.
plugins.name: bootstrap-project

plugins.description: Review and reorganize AI coding agent configuration and instruction files across Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot.
plugins.name: clean-up-agent-config

plugins.description: Smart, context-aware git commits with conventional commit messages and plan awareness.
plugins.name: commit

plugins.description: Scan the session, branch, and pull request for concerns set aside as out of scope, propose them as one batch, and file the approved ones as GitHub issues.
plugins.name: create-deferred-issues

plugins.description: Guide for creating new plugins in this repository with consistent structure and conventions.
plugins.name: create-plugin

plugins.description: Review Dependabot configuration and triage open Dependabot pull requests, applying configuration fixes or PR actions as approved.
plugins.name: dependabot

plugins.description: Best practices for handling user-provided secrets in CLI tools: secure input methods, credential storage, secret masking, and language-specific libraries.
plugins.name: handle-secrets

plugins.description: Detect project linters and formatters, run them with auto-fix, resolve remaining issues, then commit and push the fixes.
plugins.name: lint-and-fix

plugins.description: Bootstrap, audit, and maintain REUSE-style mixed-license coverage in a repository: LICENSES/, NOTICE, REUSE.toml, SPDX headers, and reuse lint cleanliness.
plugins.name: manage-repo-licensing

plugins.description: Monitor a pull request until its checks pass, Copilot signs off on the current head, and it is mergeable, fixing failures along the way, then offer the merge and sync the main worktree once it lands; resolve Copilot feedback on demand.
plugins.name: monitor-pr

plugins.description: Sends macOS notifications when Claude Code or Codex CLI finishes a task or needs your attention.
plugins.name: notify

plugins.description: Pin every version surface in a repository (action SHAs, packageManager integrity digests, dependency exact-pins, runtime version files, install commands) for one-shot supply-chain hardening.
plugins.name: pin-everything

plugins.description: Deliberately break code to prove a test can see it: plant the defect an instrument claims to catch, confirm it goes red, and record it so it regresses.
plugins.name: plant-defects

plugins.description: Lint, commit, push, and create a pull request in one step with no prompts.
plugins.name: pr

plugins.description: Publish a recurring analysis, such as backlog triage or bug triage, as a live report board with a stable URL, and re-sync it in place as the source data changes.
plugins.name: publish-report-board

plugins.description: Send push notifications through ntfy when work finishes or needs a decision, on request or from another skill, including from remote and cloud sessions.
plugins.name: push-notification

plugins.description: Refresh existing project scaffolding against the latest plugin templates.
plugins.name: refresh-project-scaffolding

plugins.description: Prepare a versioned release: update release files, create a release commit, tag locally, and optionally publish a GitHub Release.
plugins.name: release

plugins.description: Review a branch or a fix diff, read-only, against a checklist of the defect patterns that most often survive local review and surface in later Copilot rounds, such as bypassable sanitizers, parallel paths left behind, and docs that disagree with the code.
plugins.name: review-anti-patterns

plugins.description: Review and evaluate all work done on the current branch: summarize changes, assess plan compliance, and evaluate code quality.
plugins.name: review-branch

plugins.description: Review a colleague's pull request carefully and considerately from a checkout of its branch, and report a brief, read-only assessment in chat: requirements, direction, blockers, follow-ups, and questions for the author.
plugins.name: review-colleague-pr

plugins.description: Review an implementation plan against the current repository and its explicit dependencies, reporting evidence-backed blockers, required revisions, and optional improvements before work begins. Use when asked to review a plan or assess implementation readiness.
plugins.name: review-plan

plugins.description: Have Codex review the current branch in focused aspects (code, error handling, tests, comments, types), each in its own read-only run, then merge the findings into one report with an action plan.
plugins.name: review-pr-with-codex

plugins.description: Run a reviewer of your choice (a skill, slash command or CLI) over every local change, fix its findings at or above a severity threshold, and repeat until the exact snapshot on disk comes back clean or a round limit stops the loop.
plugins.name: review-until-clean

plugins.description: Scaffold a complete Go CLI project with Cobra, GoReleaser, GitHub Actions and Homebrew tap support, or add version metadata to an existing Cobra CLI.
plugins.name: scaffold-go-cli

plugins.description: Scaffold a Go library project with GoReleaser changelog-only releases, golangci-lint, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Makefile.
plugins.name: scaffold-go-library

plugins.description: Scaffold a Lean 4 library project with Mathlib or PFR dependencies, Lake test/lint wiring, GitHub Actions CI, text linting, and agent instructions.
plugins.name: scaffold-lean-library

plugins.description: Scaffold language-agnostic repository files: LICENSE, README, CHANGELOG, .gitignore, agent config and plans, with optional community files.
plugins.name: scaffold-new-repo

plugins.description: Scaffold a complete Rust CLI project with Cargo, cargo-deny, cargo-nextest, git-cliff, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Makefile.
plugins.name: scaffold-rust-cli

plugins.description: Scaffold a complete Zig CLI project with build.zig, build.zig.zon, cross-compiled releases, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Makefile.
plugins.name: scaffold-zig-cli

plugins.description: Create GitHub Actions CI and matching Makefile targets, or optimize existing workflows with path filters, concurrency groups and job timeouts.
plugins.name: set-up-ci

plugins.description: Set up installer and distribution methods for Go, Swift, Rust and Zig projects, configure GoReleaser publishing, and write or update Homebrew formulae.
plugins.name: set-up-installers

plugins.description: Detect project languages, recommend linters and formatters, install them, and generate config files, including Pandoc-academic Markdown presets.
plugins.name: set-up-linters

plugins.description: Install style-guide review checklists as a Copilot code-review skill, with matching AGENTS.md review rules and a REVIEW.md, so Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code Review apply the same guidance.
plugins.name: set-up-review-config

plugins.description: Set up secret scanning with gitleaks and TruffleHog GitHub Actions workflows and optional gitleaks configuration.
plugins.name: set-up-secret-scanning

plugins.description: Recommend the next open GitHub issue in a focused terminal answer, with reasoning, progress signals and resource constraints.
plugins.name: suggest-next-issue

plugins.description: Merge or rebase the base branch into the current branch, resolve conflicts, and push using the selected workflow.
plugins.name: sync-with-main

plugins.description: Trim and rewrite code comments so each leads with what the code does and the minimum why, cutting trivia, jargon, restatement, and details that go stale.
plugins.name: trim-comments

plugins.description: Trim and rewrite prose, such as PR and issue bodies and agent instructions, so it leads with what the reader needs and the minimum why, without changing what it says.
plugins.name: trim-text

plugins.description: Assess every version reference in a repository, evaluate available upgrades with repo-specific risk and reward, and present selectable upgrade options.
plugins.name: upgrade-everything

plugins.description: Apply git and GitHub CLI conventions for tmpfile bodies, signed commits and safe pushes, and create GitHub issues.
plugins.name: use-git

plugins.description: Create worktrees, branches and tmux windows with workmux, or launch issue planning in a new session.
plugins.name: workmux

plugins.description: Applies Bash style conventions when creating or editing Bash scripts.
plugins.name: write-bash-scripts

plugins.description: Document-structure guide for multi-milestone formalization roadmaps in Lean, Rocq, Isabelle, HOL, and other proof assistants.
plugins.name: write-formalization-roadmap

plugins.description: Go code style guide based on Google Go Style Guide, Effective Go, Code Review Comments, and Cobra CLI behavior.
plugins.name: write-go-code

plugins.description: LaTeX mathematical typesetting style guide based on AMS, IEEE, ISO 80000-2, and Knuth conventions.
plugins.name: write-latex

plugins.description: Lean 4 and Mathlib conventions for code, proofs, naming, documentation and compile-time tests that mirror the public library API.
plugins.name: write-lean-code

plugins.description: Write a numbered, resumable checklist for checks run by hand, where every step says what to do, what you should see, and how to tell nothing from broken.
plugins.name: write-manual-verification-plan

plugins.description: Applies Markdown style conventions when creating or editing Markdown files.
plugins.name: write-markdown

plugins.description: Mathematical writing and exposition guide based on Tao, Knuth, Halmos, and other leading references.
plugins.name: write-math

plugins.description: Pandoc-flavored Markdown conventions for academic papers with LaTeX output.
plugins.name: write-pandoc-markdown

plugins.description: Write and review real-time audio code: callback safety, bounded cross-thread communication, memory ordering, sample-accurate events, and compatible plugin parameters and state.
plugins.name: write-realtime-audio-code

plugins.description: Applies scrut test style conventions when creating or editing scrut test files for CLI binaries and zsh plugins.
plugins.name: write-scrut-tests

plugins.description: Zsh scripting conventions for syntax, types, expansion, scope and completions, with a workflow for syntax checks, compilation, linting and formatting.
plugins.name: write-zsh-scripts

plugins.description: Summarize where the conversation, branch, and tasks stand and what comes next, with a thorough mode that also reads the history.
plugins.name: wtaf
